title: Chapter 57
text:
"Extremely Deadly?"

Mad Blade swallowed his saliva nervously. Even the armed guards on the train were only rated as "High". This was the most dangerous person he had ever met. Other than the name, all his data were question marks. What kind of person was this?

Shouldn't the city be safe? Was he going to sacrifice his virginity today?

At this moment, Han Xiao spoke, and his first sentence almost made Mad Blade fall to the ground.

"It's very rude to detect people the moment you meet them."

Mad Blade shuddered.

According to the official website, players who used detection NPCs would be detected if there was a level difference of more than 30 levels. How could he meet such a powerful person the moment he entered the city?

Han Xiaoxin laughed in his heart. You think I don't know you guys? I used detection when I met you too!

Ever since he received the news of the beta test, Han Xiao had been thinking about getting in touch with the players. He found the starting point of all the new players on the map. The closest one was Big Horn Village, which was only a three-day journey away. However, the Germinal Organization was looking for him everywhere, and Han Xiao did not want to leave the Western Capital so easily.

Only beta testers were allowed to make posts. Han Xiao paid attention to the forums and soon found a post that analyzed the advantages of the beta test. The ID of the post was Sleepy Winter.

A god-level professional gamer who often made posts about strategies and guidance. He was a good guy, handsome, and had a huge fan base. He was also a strong player who had won many honors. In his previous life, he had always been in the top 30 of the Huaxia region's top players list. Han Xiao's best result was the 47th place, and he had even fallen out of the top 100 in the past few years. Thus, he came to a conclusion: stay away from girls and have a successful career.

Han Xiao told this conclusion to the twenty-eight-year-old single owner of the small store downstairs. The owner only smiled coldly and said, "Well said, but I choose girls."

"But girls don't choose you."

As a result, Han Xiao lost the right to enjoy a 9.5% discount in the store.

There were many types of competitions in Galaxy, such as individual battles, ring battles, team battles, mission battles, limited-time free-exploration competitions, hunting and survival competitions, positional attack and defense competitions, racing and pursuit competitions, mixed killing competitions, secret realm competitions, and so on. Small-scale duels only accounted for part of the strength. Han Xiao had been helping people seek revenge all year round, so his skill was outstanding, but he was not that good in other aspects. For example, he was not good at trash-talking, which was said to be a divine weapon against enemies, but he had always been practicing it well.

After reading the post, Han Xiao guessed that there might be closed beta players in the Western Capital. A few days ago, he had been loitering around the sentry post. As soon as the four professional players passed through the sentry post, he saw them. It wasn't that Han Xiao's eyesight was good, but he discovered that he could actually see the names above the players' heads. Wow, what a group of dazzling class IDs. They were all famous players in his previous life. It was hard not to notice them.

Is it because I have the interface? Han Xiaoxin wondered.

This was good news. Players had the detection function, so they could see the names of all NPCs. He could also recognize players in a sea of people.

Am I an NPC with the functions of a player or a player with the functions of an NPC? Han Xiaoxin couldn't help but complain.

This time, he came into contact with the players to see if his NPC functions were strong enough.

"Brave warrior, I need help. Do you have time?"

The standard opening line for a mission was cute.

Mad Blade was stunned. Although he didn't know why Han Xiao was looking for him, it didn't stop him from getting excited.

I've just entered the Western Capital and I've already triggered a high-level NPC. This is definitely my lucky day! Mad Blade was extremely excited. He tried to keep his tone as calm as possible. "I'm willing to help."

"I need a loaf of bread. Can you find it?"

As soon as he finished speaking, Han Xiao suddenly received a notification.

Do you want to issue a mission to [Mad Blade]?

It's here!

Speaking of which, my interface can actually give me NPC functions. Could it be that it can digitize all my actions?

Maybe this isn't a normal player's interface. Maybe it changed when I transmigrated. It feels pretty cool.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. Next, it was time to test out the specific effects.

"Yes."

Please set the mission requirements and rewards. There is a limit to the EXP reward. The limit depends on your level, grade, faction influence, and Legendary Points.

PS: You have the right to give additional material rewards. It can be anything that belongs to you. Money, items, EXP, skills …

An illusory box appeared in front of him. It was divided into two sides. On the left side, he could choose the type of mission. There were normal missions, prize-pool missions, competitive missions, challenge missions, series missions, running missions, faction missions, and so on.

On the right side was the limit. It was divided into two categories, 'Maximum Reward Limit' and 'Daily Limit Limit'. Currently, the EXP limit was 11,600, and the description was listed below.

Maximum Reward Limit: 11600 EXP

Total Level 24: + 7200 (After advancement, the EXP increase for each level will increase. The first advancement will increase by 300 EXP)

Grade E: + 3000

Faction: Germinal Organization (Aggro) + 1000, Division 13 (Neutral) + 400

Legendary Points: 0

The maximum reward limit was the maximum reward for a single mission. This meant that Han Xiao could only set a maximum of 11,600 EXP for a single mission.

As the name suggested, the daily limit was the maximum reward that could be given in a day. Currently, it was five times the maximum reward limit, which was 58,000 EXP. It refreshed once every 24 hours.

After Han Xiao tried it, he realized that this function was limited. If his maximum reward limit did not reach the basic reward limit of the mission difficulty, the mission would fail. For example, if he issued a mission to destroy the Germinal Organization, the difficulty of the mission would be Grade A, and the minimum reward for Grade A missions would be much higher than his limit, so the mission would fail.

With the limit of 11,600, he could only issue Grade E normal missions. The minimum requirement for Grade D missions was 30,000 EXP. Furthermore, there were different types of missions with different limits. There was no description on the interface, so Han Xiao could only try one by one. If the mission failed, there would be a notification.

It would be great if I could change the limit to my own EXP. Han Xiao whimsically tried it, but it did not work. The limit did not belong to him, and he could not issue missions for himself. The targets were limited to players.

This also confirmed his guess that he was not a player, but he had the interface.

Han Xiao pursed his lips. He only received 20,000 EXP a day, but he had a reward limit of nearly 60,000 EXP. If he put all his effort into training a player, his progress would soar. However, he would not do that.

"This function seems to be able to command players …" Han Xiao's eyes suddenly sparkled. He immediately realized the various uses of this function. The most obvious one was to attract players to do missions and become his helpers, which could be very useful in many situations.

Players' interests were paramount, and they could be treated as a group of mercenaries. As long as the rewards were good, they could be used. Players would not waste time on missions with low rewards. If you want a horse to run, you have to feed the horse. Thus, increasing the limit was imperative. The higher the limit, the more help it would be to him.

In addition to the EXP limit, Han Xiao could also use his own items as additional rewards.

Han Xiao suddenly understood. No matter what game it was, only powerful or influential high-level NPCs would issue high rewards and high difficulty missions. The principle was similar to his limit limit, but the interface showed it to him.

Han Xiao randomly set a normal mission and issued it.

At the same time, Mad Blade received the mission and was dumbfounded.

What the hell? Is a high-level NPC's mission so easy? It only requires a piece of bread, and the reward is only one dollar! Are you f * cking poor?

"Wait!" Frenzied Sword seemed to have realized something. Based on his experience playing virtual reality games, this should be a prerequisite quest, a test! Only by satisfying the NPC would the follow-up mission be triggered. If he failed, he would miss the opportunity to meet this NPC.

The more Mad Blade thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible. He directly took out seven pieces of bread (this was all the food he had) and handed them to Han Xiao. He said "sincerely", "This is all the bread I have on me. I'm giving it to you."

Han Xiao was confused.

What's going on? Are the players now used to over-completing missions? Why is this different from what I remember?

After taking the bread, the mission notification said that everything had gone smoothly. Han Xiao nodded.

There were many types of missions, and Han Xiao did not plan to try them all immediately. He wanted to test the other NPC functions first.

Han Xiao noticed that next to Mad Blade's ID, a small symbol appeared. Han Xiao focused on the symbol, and a new notification appeared on the interface. An illusory thing that looked like a health bar appeared in front of him. Only he could see that a small pointer stopped in the middle. The left was red, and the right was green.

Do you want to adjust the favorability of [Mad Blade's]?

This thing can be adjusted?

Han Xiao was dumbfounded. Will this change my mind? If I max it all out, will I suddenly become gay?

No, I can't take the risk!

Han Xiao tried to move the pointer to the right … no, to the left, and the favorability decreased by five points. He found that his thoughts did not change, and he was relieved. Luckily, the favorability was only a numerical value and did not affect his true thoughts.

This function seems a bit useless … Han Xiao thought.

…

Han Xiao's favorability decreased by five points. Current relationship is cold.

Why would the favorability decrease after completing the mission?

Mad Blade was dumbfounded.

What the hell!
